sources.title: Design and Implementation of the POWER5 Microprocessor
sources.what_it_covers: Clock distribution, power delivery grid, and physical design closure challenges for the dual-core POWER5 processor.
sources.why_relevant: Covers high-frequency physical design, CTS routing, and power distribution recovery strategies under strict thermal and noise constraints.

sources.title: Physical Design and Structural Implementation of the POWER6 Microprocessor
sources.venue_or_publication: IBM Journal of Research and Development, vol. 51, no. 6, pp. 711-722
sources.what_it_covers: Physical design execution, clock delivery, timing closure, and layout methodology for the ultra-high frequency 4.7GHz POWER6 chip.
sources.why_relevant: Details extreme timing closure and clock distribution challenges requiring specialized physical-design recovery workflows.
sources.verification_hint: IBM Journal of Research and Development POWER6 physical design timing closure

sources.title: Clocking and Physical Design Issues in the Itanium 2 Processor
sources.venue_or_publication: IEEE Journal of Solid-State Circuits, vol. 37, no. 11, pp. 1415-1425
sources.what_it_covers: Clock tree synthesis, global routing congestion, and timing closure for McKinley (Itanium 2).
sources.why_relevant: Provides insight into physical closure war stories for heavy 64-bit wide execution buses and custom skew management.
sources.verification_hint: Clocking and Physical Design Issues in the Itanium 2 Processor ISSCC JSSC

sources.title: Physical Design Methodology for a 64b x86 Microprocessor
sources.what_it_covers: Floorplanning, timing closure, CTS, and signal integrity closure for AMD's Opteron/K8 cores.
sources.why_relevant: Covers congestion, wire delay mitigation, and floorplan recovery on full-custom x86 microprocessor implementation.
